title: Endmites
description: Aims to spice up the end by introducing two new mobs and a new plant called the Miteling.
body:
![Endmites Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c2350de6c600b344d1b499c6f3552bb06ab3c385.png)

# **About Endmites**

This mod aims to adds vanilla-like mobs and a plant to spice up the end a little, all while attempting to stay close to the vanilla feel. There are a few new crafting recipes and advancements centered around the new additons as well.



## Whats in the Mod

Everything this mod has to offer is in the end dimension, however once you have access to the outer end islands, you can begin to search for the new additions.

* 2 new hostile entities.
* 1 new plant, when fully grown spawns shulkermites and drops Miteling shrub. And naturally spawning Cloakmite Eggs.
* 2 new foods, the Mite Grub that sometimes grants levitation which shulkermites and cloakmites drop, and Mite Grub Soup.
 * 5 new recipes, including the Shulkermite Bowl, Mite Grub Soup, a way to craft shulker shells, and a new fuel source.
* 5 new advancements to guide you in your journey.

## Meet the additions

![A Cloakmite and a Shulkermite](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/543eb416a44d67a866800c2f74e31a20ef175481_0.webp)

Cloakmites & Shulkermites -- Two new entities native to the end dimension, cloakmites are centered around stealth, while shulkermites drop useful **Shulkermite Shells**.

![Fully grown Miteling plant](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bdca53f1e7d9e32979541fe0d238aa73117d3585.png)

The Miteling plant -- A new plant unique to the end dimension. Be careful not to disturb them however, as shulkermites tend to make their home in them.

### The first version of the mod is available for download.
* Which just includes the miteling plant, the shulkermite and its recipes.
